Meanwhile: the coordinator keeps releasing lanes that fix work on main.

title: Allow one push past the record-branch guard, so each child repo's items land in its outbox?
why: It follows your 11:07 CST yes at once, and the guard's refusal of an own outbox file may be a false alarm (a filed note says the guard may wrongly block a session's own outbox file).
